meet your coach

From Systems to Souls, Logic to Light.

An IT professional for over 30 years, Malavika Hegde made a transformative shift into mind coaching, tuning into her soul-driven purpose to become a Mind Coach and Counsellor.

“I understand the silent struggles of people who display happiness and success on the outside while carrying loads of pain from the inside.”

Read her story

who is this for

For anyone carrying pain the world can't see.

Anyone aged 18–80, working professionals, homemakers and retired personnel. Especially those who feel any of this:

  • Doing well outside, broken inside
  • A deep sense of emptiness
  • Stuck in negative thinking
  • Self-sabotaging patterns
  • Mood swings, loneliness & low moods
  • Entangled karmic relationships
  • Emotional overload
  • Striving with no inner happiness

words from the heart

Real reflections from real sessions.

Yashaswini Viswanath 1-to-1 Counselling
I was at a crucial juncture in my life when I came to Malavika ma'am for a counselling session. She gave me a few tools to practice. Once I started practicing Gratitude and Thought Journalling, there was a big shift in me and I began carrying a lot of positivity towards life. With this new state, I am now very confident and getting ready to take on more responsibilities. Lots of gratitude to Malavika ma'am. Thank you.
Akanksha Dhawan Healing Journey
A loud appreciation and tons of gratitude for the healing guidance and support from Malavika, especially during a personal downfall. Divinely, she came into my life at the exact point I needed her, and in just a few sessions I could see the magic. The stress and anxiety vanished, I reclaimed my power and started doing big things, I completed the healing certification myself and am now a certified healer, handling everything at work and in personal life with ease. Along with being an IT consultant and a fashion model, I'm now an author as well. Healing actually brings you back, that's my experience with Malavika.
